Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, wb2 As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ws2 As Worksheet, co As Object, co2 As Object
    Dim s As String, s0 As String
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet): Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    Set ws2 = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws): ws.Activate
    ws.Range("A1:A4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("k", "a", "b", "c"))
    ws.Range("B1:B4").Value = Application.Transpose(Array("v", 1, 2, 3))
    ws.Range("B2").Select
    Set co = ws.ChartObjects.Add(150, 10, 200, 120): co.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    co.Chart.ChartType = xlColumnClustered
    Set co2 = ws.ChartObjects.Add(150, 150, 200, 120): co2.Chart.SetSourceData ws.Range("A1:B4")
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
    Case 1
        co.Activate
    Case 2
        co.Chart.Activate
    Case 3
        co.Select
    Case 4
        co.Chart.Select
    Case 5
        co.Activate: ws.Range("C3").Select
    Case 6
        co.Activate: ws.Range("C3").Activate
    Case 7
        co.Activate: ws2.Activate
    Case 8
        co.Activate: ws2.Activate: ws.Activate
    Case 9
        co.Activate: co.Delete
    Case 10
        co.Activate: co2.Activate
    Case 11
        co.Activate: ActiveChart.ChartType = xlLine
    Case 12
        co.Activate: ActiveCell.Value = 5
    Case 13
        co.Activate: Set wb2 = Workbooks.Add: s0 = TypeName(ActiveChart) & "/" & TypeName(wb.ActiveChart): wb2.Close False
    Case 14
        co.Activate: Set wb2 = Workbooks.Add: wb2.Close False
    Case 15
        co.Activate: ActiveWindow.ActiveCell.Select
    Case 16
        co.Activate: ws.Shapes(2).Select
    Case 17
        co.Activate: Application.Goto ws.Range("D4")
    Case 18
        co.Activate: ws.Range("C3").Value = 1
    Case 19
        co.Activate: co.Chart.ChartArea.Select
    Case 20
        co.Activate: ActiveWindow.RangeSelection.Select
    End Select
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ActiveChart)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ActiveChart.Parent.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(wb.ActiveChart)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(ActiveWindow.ActiveChart)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & TypeName(Selection)
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ActiveCell.Address
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ActiveWindow.RangeSelection.Address
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ActiveSheet.Name
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & co.Chart.ChartType
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ws.Range("A1").Value
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & ws.ChartObjects.Count
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    Err.Clear
    s = s & "," & s0
    If Err.Number Then s = s & "E" & Err.Number
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = "ok " & Mid(s, 2)
Closed:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Closed
End Function

Public Function Probe() As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    For i = 0 To 20
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
